title: Deuteronomy 18:18 — “I will raise up a prophet … like you [Moses]”
summary: Deuteronomy 18:18 in English and Hebrew: God promises to raise up a prophet like Moses from among the people and put His words in his mouth. “Prophet” and the pronouns referring to him (his, he, him) are highlighted in gold, matching the Hebrew נביא (navi, prophet).

text.text: 18 'I will raise up a prophet from among their countrymen like you [Moses], and I will put My words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I command him.
18 נביא אקים להם מקרב אחיהם כמוך ונתתי דברי בפיו ודבר אליהם את כל־אשר אצונו׃

keywords: I will raise up a prophet
put my words in his mouth
uncertain: The letters of “My” are coloured blue (M) and red (y) and underlined in gold; “y” of “you” and “Mo” of “Moses” are pale blue — the meaning of these colour accents is not stated.
